title: Cardmember Rush Discount — Marlowe & Finch Alterations Benefit Bulletin
content:
Holders of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards receive a cardmember rush discount on rush work at Marlowe & Finch Alterations, set by the card accounts the customer holds and their status:

| Card accounts the customer holds | Cardmember rush discount |
|---|---|
| An active Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite account or an active Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard account | 10 percent |
| Active Marlowe & Finch card accounts, none of which is a Store Card Elite or a World Elite Mastercard | 5 percent |
| No active Marlowe & Finch card account | none |

**Records read.** The customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts: which card each account is (Store Card, Store Card Plus, Store Card Elite, Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard or World Elite Mastercard) and whether its status is active. An account that is not active counts for nothing.

## Combinations

| Accounts held (status) | Discount |
|---|---|
| Store Card Elite (active) and Store Card (active) | 10 percent |
| World Elite Mastercard (active) only | 10 percent |
| Platinum Mastercard (active) and Store Card Plus (active) | 5 percent |
| Store Card (active) and Store Card Elite (closed) | 5 percent |
| World Elite Mastercard (closed) only | none |
| No card account | none |

## Basis Q&A

**Does holding two active Elite-level accounts give 20 percent?** No. The discount is one figure for the customer: 10 percent when at least one active Store Card Elite or World Elite Mastercard account is held.
